cp750.title: Dolby CP750
cp750.description: ASCII control port is usually 61408. Starts in read-only mode.

cp850.title: Dolby CP850
cp850.description: ASCII control port is usually 61408. The web interface login (factory default admin/admin) is only needed for the Atmos sensor (leave empty = no Atmos sensor). Starts in read-only mode.

cp950.title: Dolby CP950 / CP950A
cp950.description: ASCII control port is usually 61408. The web interface login (factory default admin/admin) is only needed for the Atmos sensor (CP950A only; leave empty = no Atmos sensor). Starts in read-only mode.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Leave the password empty to keep the stored one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the processor's control port.
error.web_unreachable: Control port reachable, but the web interface is not.

data_description.read_only: Blocks all commands (input/macro, volume, mute, writing raw commands).
data_description.macros: One macro per line as "number=name", e.g. 1=5.1 + Dolby Atmos. Macros that were active once are learned automatically.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends an ASCII line to the control port and returns all replies, e.g. "sys.fader ?" or "help". In read-only mode only queries (…?), help and status are allowed.
